# biznetgio_object_storage (Resource)

Object Storage subscribed instance (the S3-compatible tenant) on BiznetGIO. Create orders the instance; quota can be grown via update. Label, cycle and product are immutable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Subscribed Object Storage instance. Polls until Active before proceeding.
resource "biznetgio_object_storage" "example" {
  product_id           = "8"
  cycle                = "m"
  label                = "data-archive"
  quota                = 10
  pay_with_credit_card = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cycle` (String) Billing cycle: m=monthly, q=quarterly, s=semi-annual, a=annual, b=biennial, t=triennial, p4/p5=4/5-year prepay.
- `label` (String) Instance label, 6-16 chars, `[a-zA-Z0-9-_]`. Immutable (no rename endpoint).
- `product_id` (Number) Product/plan id from the object storage catalog.

### Optional

- `pay_with_credit_card` (Boolean) Pay the invoice with the card on file. Set false to leave the invoice unpaid in the portal; the resource stays Pending until paid.
- `promocode` (String) Promo/discount code applied at order time.
- `quota` (Number) Total quota in GB, minimum 10. Only growable: update sends the delta as add_quota.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Account id of the object storage instance.
- `order_id` (String) Order id from the create call.
- `raw` (String, Sensitive) Full JSON of the last read from the API, for anything not modeled yet.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status: Active, Pending, Suspended or Terminated.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing Object Storage instance by its account id.
terraform import biznetgio_object_storage.example 12345
```
